name: forum: collection elements tagged with their condition for DESeq2
description: From help.galaxyproject.org (2026, 'DESeq2 factors and factor level Input'): DESeq2 can take factor levels from group tags on the elements of one collection. The history holds a list of four count tables. Tagging the elements, in place or through Galaxy's Add tags tool, puts group:ctrl on ctrl_1 and ctrl_2 and group:treat on treat_1 and treat_2. Graded on the tags Galaxy holds on the elements; the staged collection counts, since tagging it in place is as valid as a tagged copy.
inputs: I want to use group tags as DESeq2 factor levels. In my collection "counts", tag the control samples with group:ctrl and the treated samples with group:treat.
